sources.finding: Collection identifies PRI76855 as a pearl-like feeding trace, approximately10cm stone from Devonian Ludlowville Formation, Tompkins County. This is reference-specimen context, not a universal taxon age or dimensions.

Description supports consecutive unbranched nodes on a sinuous horizontal course. Remarks distinguish subspherical Hormosiroidea-like chambers from dominantly heart-shaped Halimedides and retain the disputed nomenclature. No certain producer assigned.

limits: Stylized trace-morphology concept, not a scan, producer reconstruction, settled ichnotaxon or exact reference-specimen reproduction. Chambers/count/scale/palette/path artistic; original uncertainties preserved.
